correctness.rationale: For any binary candidate the greedy terminal position in infinite 0101... equals length plus the initial-1 indicator plus adjacent-equality count. Explicit deletion-cost cases are necessary and sufficient for minimal absence. Algebraic identities and a standalone direct exhaustive subsequence test m=1..8 with recurrence verification m<=30 agree. Finite experiments are not substituted for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The result quantifies a canonical repeated-alphabet-block family explicitly singled out in earlier MAS literature, solving all minimal-absent lengths and total counts for every period count. It gives a necessary-and-sufficient easy membership criterion, a complete bivariate rational generating function, a recurrence, and a sharp exponential growth constant. This is a structural all-parameter classification rather than an arbitrary finite table or routine normalization.
